title: Disposable Compass
description: Turn Nature's Compass and Explorer's Compass into one-destination navigation items with shift-right-click search-next.
body:
# Disposable Compass

**Turn Nature's Compass and Explorer's Compass into one-destination navigation items.**

Disposable Compass makes the two compass mods behave more like filled maps: once a compass is assigned to its first target, that same item keeps that destination and cannot be reused to pick a different biome or structure.

![Locked compass message in-game](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/4zZvjqC8/images/9475702670c2b23cc40bbe3965fc4ef3eb4d0cbc_350.webp)

## What it does

- Locks a **Nature's Compass** after the first biome is selected.
- Locks an **Explorer's Compass** after the first structure or structure group is selected.
- Blocks reopening the selection screen on locked compasses.
- Changes shift-right-click on locked compasses from reset into “search next”.
- Keeps the selected biome or structure type fixed while allowing the item to find the next matching location.

This is useful for exploration-focused packs where biome and structure compasses should be committed navigation items instead of reusable global search tools.

![Disposable compass items in inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/4zZvjqC8/images/943c62179b6f72177c11a0c4e6a6c71ec45a000b_350.webp)

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge
- Nature's Compass
- Explorer's Compass

Install on both client and server.
